headline: Receiving and explaining to finalize regulations on debt instrument transactions, enhancing payment safety
summary: A draft circular replacing Circular No. 30/2019/TT-BTC is being finalised to clarify responsibilities of participating organisations and enhance payment safety. It also aims to reduce unnecessary reporting requirements.
why: Rules governing debt instrument trading set the operating framework for bond market participants, affecting market efficiency and settlement safety.
